text: Lesson 1 opened with leadership's real complaint. The strongest way to present this finished platform isn't a tour of dbt and Snowflake — it's answering that original complaint, point by point, in their own language.

Structure it around their five original gaps: roles that stop anyone from breaking anything, real tests catching real mistakes, a live lineage graph anyone can click through, a scheduled ingestion script, and a CI gate that blocks bad changes.
Translate every technical fact into its business outcome. dbt build stopping on a failed test becomes: a mistake gets caught before it reaches a dashboard, not after.
The single strongest proof point is the real incident from Lessons 23 and 24 — a genuine mistake, a reasonable developer could have made it, and it never reached a single business user.
A list of tools means nothing to someone who asked for trust in the numbers. Nothing broke silently is the real pitch. Next: a final wrap-up of everything this capstone built.
